item.description: The async_notify method in Apprise class is not correctly handling the return value for async operations, causing test failures in test_apprise_async.
item.contract: The async_notify method should properly return boolean values indicating success/failure of notifications, matching the behavior of the sync notify method. The method should handle exceptions properly and return False for failures, True for successes, and None when no notifications are sent.

item.description: URL parsing and validation logic in the base plugin class is incomplete or inconsistent across different plugins, causing URL parsing test failures in multiple plugins (dapnet, feishu, office365, etc.).
item.contract: The parse_url method in NotifyBase should consistently handle URL parsing for all plugins, correctly extracting and validating parameters like format, overflow, emojis, store, and tz. The method should return proper dictionaries with validated parameters or None for invalid URLs.

item.description: Missing or incorrect implementation of the _build_send_calls method that affects notification behavior and error handling in several plugins.
item.contract: The _build_send_calls method should properly validate inputs and generate send calls for notifications. It should handle disabled plugins gracefully and return empty generators when appropriate.

item.description: Incorrect handling of notification return values in the async notification flow that causes test failures related to return value consistency.
item.contract: The _notify_parallel_asyncio static method should properly process async notifications and return boolean values representing success/failure of all notifications. It should handle exceptions and return False for any failure.

item.description: Missing or incomplete implementation of the async_notify method in the base plugin class that prevents proper async behavior in notification plugins.
item.contract: The async_notify method in NotifyBase should be properly implemented to handle asynchronous notifications, delegating to the send method appropriately. It should handle the same parameters as the sync notify method and return boolean values.
